t: G48 Simulation Engine: Landauer Floor Desk — Simple
name: G48 Simulation Engine: Landauer Floor Desk — Simple
title: G48 Simulation Engine: Landauer Floor Desk — Simple
description:

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Landauer floor per bit at 300 K = 2.87 zJ. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
